say:1:1730505801:0.text: Ah, a ghost!!! Wait, I can see your breath... You're alive!
say:1:1730505801:0.source_cn: 吓死我了！等等，你说话有呼出白气……你是活人！
say:1:1730505801:0.male: Ah, a ghost!!! Wait, I can see your breath... You're alive!
say:1:1730505801:0.female: Ah, a ghost!!! Wait, I can see your breath... You're alive!

say:2:1730505802:1.text: Finally! I've been waiting here for ages... I thought I wouldn't see another living person until dawn!
say:2:1730505802:1.source_cn: 太好了！我在这里守了这么久……我以为自己要等到天亮才能...
say:2:1730505802:1.male: Finally! I've been waiting here for ages... I thought I wouldn't see another living person until dawn!
say:2:1730505802:1.female: Finally! I've been waiting here for ages... I thought I wouldn't see another living person until dawn!

say:4:1730505803:1.text: They say vampires show up in the graveyard at night, and a portal to another dimension might appear. So here I am, trying my luck.
say:4:1730505803:1.source_cn: 我听说墓地半夜会有吸血鬼出没，还有可能进入另一个时空！...
say:4:1730505803:1.male: They say vampires show up in the graveyard at night, and a portal to another dimension might appear. So here I am, trying my luck.
say:4:1730505803:1.female: They say vampires show up in the graveyard at night, and a portal to another dimension might appear. So here I am, trying my luck.

say:5:1730505804:1.text: But I've been on edge this whole time, all alone... Honestly, it's such a relief to see another living person!
say:5:1730505804:1.source_cn: 不过担惊受怕到现在我觉得碰见活人才是最好的！
